item.text: The key distinction is between a controller version, a canvas checkpoint, and an issued diagram revision. I’ll make those bindings explicit, center the tree on command publication and saved-view behavior, and condense peripheral details.

{"ascii":"Canvas Commands and History
|-- MappingDocumentController turns edits into semantic checkpoints
|   |-- Headless/API: transact -> applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |   `-- settle pending live gesture -> compare expectedVersion with snapshot.version
|   |       `-- mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT; caller must read current canvas state
|   |-- Live editor: commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
|   |   `-- uses current controller version; includes selection/layout consequences
|   |-- Shared batch path
|   |   |-- clone document + canvas -> apply operations sequentially
|   |   |   `-- later operations consume earlier staged changes
|   |   |-- check each operation's contract
|   |   |   |-- revision application/context changes check the issued diagram revision
|   |   |   `-- mappings and anchors use their own content-hash/node checks
|   |   `-- finish layout + reconcile links + normalize selection/view state
|   |       `-- CanvasHistoryService.append -> publish controller snapshot -> notify listeners
|   |           `-- validation failure prevents publication of the staged checkpoint
|   `-- Version scope is the controller snapshot, not a diagram or storage revision
|       |-- native gesture commits supply their version internally
|       |-- saved-view mutations check expectedVersion; list/read bypass that check
|       `-- transient selection/layout updates can avoid a checkpoint and version increment
|
|-- A checkpoint binds reusable content to canvas composition
|   |-- Placement identity: GridBox.id; display address: grid:<GridBox.id>
|   |   `-- diagram box.contentId -> scene.contents[contentId] in the resolved document
|   |       `-- duplicate-instance adds a placement sharing the same content
|   |-- StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   |-- id + parentId identify the canvas checkpoint and its ancestry
|   |   |-- document stores placement tree, connections and composition metadata
|   |   |   `-- canonical scene stores root; diagram contents are resolved separately
|   |   |-- diagramBindings[contentId] -> exact issued revision ID
|   |   |   |-- contentId is the local Diagram.id; Diagram.diagramId is logical identity
|   |   |   `-- CanvasHistory retains issued revisions and referenced dependencies [diagrams]
|   |   `-- view stores personal state separately from composition
|   |-- documentFromHistory(checkpoint)
|   |   `-- bindings + retained revision table -> resolved contents for rendering/transport
|   |-- LineGrid resolves hierarchical placement
|   |   |-- relative cell positions -> absolute bounds; containers hold child boxes
|   |   |-- collapsed boxes show summary content and hide children
|   |   `-- layoutScene anchors changed subtree -> pushes colliding siblings right
|   |       `-- final bounds/collision checks run before returning the layout
|   `-- Connection anchors consume parsed content nodes [parsing]
|       |-- content endpoint = placement + contentNodeId + Diagram.content.revisionId
|       |   `-- this content identity differs from the issued diagram revision binding
|       |-- edge create/update requires current changed endpoints; unchanged ones may stay stale
|       |-- reconciliation after edits
|       |   |-- deleted endpoint placement -> remove incident edge
|       |   |-- proven node mapping, or unchanged text/structure with matching position -> rebase
|       |   `-- otherwise retain the stale anchor without guessing
|       `-- checkpoint encoding uses revision.nodeRefs for logical node identity
|           `-- decoding resolves current content-node IDs; already-stale anchors remain explicit
|
|-- CanvasHistory owns navigation through retained checkpoints
|   |-- CanvasHistoryService maps runtime context handles to isolated histories
|   |   `-- separate viewers can share a persisted context ID without sharing mutable history
|   |-- append: validate -> retain revisions -> add checkpoint -> advance head
|   |   `-- previous head enters past; future is cleared
|   |-- undo/redo move head between past and future, restoring document + personal view
|   |   `-- live editor delegates restoration to archived semantic checkpoints
|   |-- edit after undo creates a new branch
|   |   `-- redo route disappears; archived checkpoints and revisions remain retained
|   |-- reset copies the baseline into a new checkpoint; reset itself is undoable
|   `-- headless proposal boundary
|       |-- fork keeps archive, creates new context/baseline, clears navigation stacks
|       `-- adopt validates proposed history -> one new checkpoint with exact revision IDs
|
|-- CanvasView owns named saved states and working branches
|   |-- saved metadata sits outside the state restored by undo/apply
|   |   `-- pins start/final checkpoints, ancestry, alternative groups and working copies
|   |-- create/save pins current state; subsequent saves advance the endpoint reference
|   |-- open another view
|   |   `-- stash active working copy -> resume target working copy or saved endpoint
|   |       `-- restore as a fresh checkpoint while retaining the current camera
|   |-- fork creates and opens a child from its parent's saved endpoint
|   |-- alternatives creates independent children from ONE saved endpoint
|   |   `-- leaves active canvas unchanged; conversation coordination belongs to [chat]
|   |-- keep opens/saves the chosen candidate and archives group siblings + descendants
|   |-- discard archives a view + descendants; delete requires a leaf
|   |-- recording: start -> collect visited checkpoints -> stop pins endpoints
|   |   `-- cancel removes recording metadata while retaining edits
|   |-- comparison reads pinned start/final states and their revision dependencies
|   |   `-- dirty compares composition, bindings and view state excluding viewport/selection
|   `-- generation handoff: accept a validated finished proposal as a saved endpoint
|       `-- updates candidate history without switching the live head
|
|-- Checkpoint publication supplies the persistence handoff
|   |-- controller snapshot exposes version, canvasRevisionId and undo/redo availability
|   |   `-- canvasRevisionId is the current checkpoint ID
|   |-- persistenceChanges(since) -> sequence + navigation header + changed checkpoints/revisions
|   |   `-- checkpoint encoder supplies storage records for the persistence adapter [workspace]
|   |       `-- delivery acknowledgement and durable visibility belong downstream [persistence]
|   `-- current-only export pins the real head and required revisions
|       `-- saved views/recording require full export to preserve their checkpoint graph
|
`-- CanvasTransfer prepares changes across two canvases
    |-- isolated source/destination histories -> prepared states + transaction -> workspace publication
    |-- copy creates fresh placement/content IDs, preserving sharing within the selection
    |   `-- copies edges with both endpoints selected; source history remains unchanged
    |-- move removes selected source placements and content no longer used there
    |   `-- preserves IDs where possible; converts source edges to jumps and redirects moved targets
    `-- transaction pins before/after checkpoint IDs on both canvases
        |-- undo/redo requires both heads at the expected boundaries; newer edits must be undone first
        |-- coordinated navigation restores both sides for move, destination for copy
        `-- ordinary history-service navigation rejects linked transfers and directs callers to workspace"}
